extraction.Name: Peter Mesteth
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his allotment of 160, at the time he got it, but was told that he would have to take it, so he accepted it
extraction.Buyer: sold 1523 acres to L.D.Bailey, of Oelrichs, South Dakota, for $2600.00, $1800.00 in cash, and $800.00 in consideration on a car trade; in the same year he sold 72 acres to the United States Government for school purposes, receiving $120.00, cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: in 1921, he being one year back in taxes, he sold 1523 acres to L.D.Bailey
extraction.Occupation/Income: employed by Holy Rosary Mission School, the year around, farming for them, and that is the only source of his income
extraction.NOTES: has never received any help from the County or the Government; has a wife and two minor children to support; family has good health; affidavit dated November 17, 1928; document reference 302-763
